caption: Table 3. Bootloader protocol versions
section: 3 Evolution of the bootloader protocol versions
rows: – Updated the Acknowledge mechanism. – Updated the "Get", "Get ID", "Get Version" and "Read" commands.
– Added support for "Get Checksum" command. – Updated "Get Command" command to return the opcode of the "Get Checksum" command.
– The number of commands can vary on STM32 devices with the same protocol version v2.0. To know the supported commands, use Get command.
